slides.headline: THIS IS WHAT A COMPLETE FILE LOOKS LIKE.
slides.sub: Most are missing three of them.
slides.note: The gap between an almost-complete file and a complete one is where refusals live.

slides.headline: WHAT BELONGS IN IT
items: A cover letter written around your case
A day-by-day itinerary that matches everything else

slides.body: A complete file submitted to the wrong post is still the wrong application.
slides.note: Everything else is downstream of that one decision.

slides.headline: WHERE COMPLETE FILES STILL FAIL
slides.never: Assemble every document correctly but never cross-check them against each other. Seven correct documents that disagree on dates read worse than five that agree.
slides.instead: Audit the set as a whole — dates, amounts, addresses, purpose — so the file tells one story from first page to last.
